title: Eclipse Devourer
summary: With all ten Relics gathered, Ha-Jun masters the full authority of the Eclipse Devourer, awakening his personal Shadow Army of ancient sovereign champions.

panels.shot: the ten relics orbiting ha-jun in a celestial planetary ring
panels.action: Feather, Ring, Bone, Heart, Fang, Eye, Chains, Crown, Devourer, and Hourglass circle Ha-Jun in blinding light.

panels.shot: ten-colored celestial halo blazing behind ha-jun head
panels.action: A ten-spoke wheel of violet, crimson, ivory, indigo, and gold light burns like a star behind Ha-Jun's crown.

panels.shot: system interface global announcement
panels.action: A world-tier diamond interface unfurls across the entire sky of the Demon Realm.

dialogue.text:
[UNIVERSAL ACHIEVEMENT: ALL 10 RELICS ASSEMBLED]
Bloodline Synchronization: 65.0%
True Sovereign Dominion: PERMANENT
New Authority: Shadow Monarch Manifestation (Shadow Legion Capacity: 10,000).

panels.shot: valac bowing his forehead against the crystal terrace
panels.action: Lord Valac presses his face to the cold stone: 'My Lord... Forgive my treason! I submit to the True Sovereign!'

dialogue.speaker: valac
dialogue.text: Mera Shadow Realm aapka hai! Meri aatma aapki daasi hai!

panels.shot: ha-jun looking down with calm sovereign detachment
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks down at the groveling demon lord: 'Tumhari punishment yeh hai ki tum mere Shadow Vanguard ke subordinate banoge.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kuro tumhara commander hoga. Ek bhi galti hui... Toh Eclipse Devourer tumhara dinner karega.

panels.shot: kuro puffing chest with grand familiar pride
panels.action: Kuro cackles with evil satisfaction: 'Suna tune, Valac?! Ab tum mere order follow karoge! Hahahaha!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Go clean my nest on Mount Obsidian! Move it!

panels.shot: tae-jun landing on the terrace riding his wyvern
panels.action: Tae-Jun leaps down from the black wyvern saddle, running to Ha-Jun with a proud, beaming grin.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun! Pura time rift normal ho gaya! Tumne Lilith aur Valac dono ko neutralise kar diya!

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling warmly at tae-jun
panels.action: Ha-Jun clasps his brother's forearm: 'Bhai... Mummy aur Papa ka badla pura hua. Lilith mar chuki hai.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Unhone humein azaad kiya tha... Aaj humne unhe shanti di.

panels.shot: tae-jun eyes filling with tears of peace
panels.action: Tae-Jun looks up at the twin moons, a lone tear of peace slipping down his cheek: 'Rest in peace, Ma... Papa.'

panels.shot: ha-jun turning toward the vast empty terrace
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks at the expansive 200-meter white crystal floor: 'Now... Let me test the Shadow Legion.'

panels.shot: ha-jun thrusting eclipse devourer tip into the crystal floor
panels.action: Ha-Jun plunges the tip of the dark-matter greatsword into the center of the clock dial.

panels.shot: black liquid shadow spilling outward in concentric waves
panels.action: A pool of pitch-black liquid darkness spreads outward across the white crystal floor like spilled ink.

panels.shot: ha-jun speaking the sovereign command of resurrection
panels.action: Ha-Jun's voice resonates in ten dimensions: 'Arise, soldiers of the Sovereign. ARISE!'

panels.shot: thousands of black armored hands erupting from the shadows
panels.action: From the liquid shadow pool, thousands of armored obsidian gauntlets punch upward toward the sky.

panels.shot: one thousand shadow knights rising to full height
panels.action: One thousand towering demonic Shadow Knights in obsidian armor and flowing violet plumes rise in unison.

panels.shot: centurion general vaelor leading the shadow frontline
panels.action: At the front of the army: the resurrected Skeletal Centurion General Vaelor, holding his bone broadsword.

dialogue.speaker: vaelor_shadow
dialogue.text: General Vaelor, at the Sovereign's command once more!

panels.shot: one thousand shadow knights slamming fists to chests in salute
panels.action: All one thousand shadow warriors strike their breastplates in synchronized, deafening military homage.

panels.shot: tae-jun watching with jaw dropped in pure awe
panels.action: Tae-Jun watches the silent shadow army: 'An immortal army that lives inside your shadow... Incredible.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Yeh army kabhi nahi thakti, kabhi nahi marti... Aur tumhare mind se direct sync hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun raising right hand to command the legion
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks over his troops: 'Disperse and secure the perimeter of the Temporal Temple.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Perimeter secure karo. Hum yahan se Mount Obsidian lautenge.

panels.shot: shadow knights dissolving into floor shadows to patrol
panels.action: The thousand shadow soldiers sink seamlessly back into the floor shadows, patrolling like silent phantoms.

panels.shot: ha-jun recalling the eclipse devourer to his hand
panels.action: Ha-Jun pulls the blade from the floor, sheathing it across his back.

panels.shot: ha-jun holding the hourglass of eternal abyss
panels.action: Ha-Jun cradles the 3-foot diamond hourglass in his arms; the golden sands flow peacefully downward now.

panels.shot: kuro looking at the hourglass with quiet respect
panels.action: Kuro notes: 'Hourglass hamare paas hai... Lekin iska use sirf ultimate emergency mein hi karna.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Yaad rakhna: Memory loss permanent hota hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun nodding firmly: 'I remember.'
panels.action: Ha-Jun nods: 'Main ise tab tak use nahi karunga jab tak duniya ka aakhri option na bache.'

panels.shot: sudden transmission ping in ha-jun earpiece
panels.action: After three days of radio silence, Min-Jae's voice suddenly crackles through the earpiece.

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: HA-JUN!! CAN YOU HEAR ME?! EMERGENCY IN SEOUL!!

panels.shot: ha-jun touching earpiece in alert surprise
panels.action: Ha-Jun presses the earpiece: 'Min-Jae?! Signal connect ho gaya?! Earth par kya ho raha hai?!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Min-Jae, report karo! Kya hua Seoul mein?!

panels.shot: min-jae voice breaking through panic
panels.action: Min-Jae screams: 'Multiple colossal Abyssal Gates open ho chuke hain! Tokyo, New York, Seoul!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Yeh Demon Lords nahi hain... Yeh kuch bohot bada hai! The Void Primordial has initiated global invasion!!

panels.shot: tae-jun stepping up with drawn swords
panels.action: Tae-Jun grips his short-swords: 'The Void Primordial... Usne hamare Demon Realm mein hone ka faayda uthaya!'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Usne Earth par direct strike kiya hai jab hum yahan the!

panels.shot: ha-jun eyes igniting with diamond-hard resolution
panels.action: Ha-Jun clenches his fists, Crown blazing with radiant solar violet power.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Humne Demon Realm ko unite kiya... Ab hum apne home world ko protect karne lautenge.

panels.shot: ha-jun raising eclipse devourer to open a massive portal to seoul
panels.action: Ha-Jun slashes empty space; a 100-meter golden-violet gate tears open directly toward the Seoul skyline.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: All legions... To Earth! We defend our home!
